page0.text:
"Ugh..."
Caster's regained her consciousness.
With Kuzuki by her side, she extends her awareness to the entire church.

page1.text:
...It was all for naught.
Ambushes won't work on Caster anymore.
Tohsaka barely has any strength left, and I only have two swords left.
...This is bad.
If they use "her" to attack us in this state, we won't able to see the light of day ever again...

page2.text:
"...That was close. I have to offer you my thanks, Master. If it wasn't for you, I would've been defeated right there and then."
"Save it. Wake Saber up now. It seems they're not ones who should be underestimated."
"Quite the keen observation, Master."
Caster raises her hand and points at "her" on the altar.

page3.text:
"She" is visibly bound by magical curses.
Just as Caster is about to set "her" free...

page4.text: "...Right. You know, had you done that just a few seconds faster."

page5.text:
The sound came from above.
I can hear the whisper coming from the stairs above me.

page6.text:
...
Caster was the first one that noticed something was wrong.
Kuzuki can't tell.
Why? Because Kuzuki can't detect traces of magical energy.

page7.text:
Caster is on the move.
Countless amount of swords can be seen...
Floating above Caster's Master...
Above Souichirou Kuzuki.
"Souichirou!"
Perhaps Caster understood that she wouldn't be able to block the attack.
She now stands in front of her Master trying to shield him from the assault.

page9.text: I was certain...that the voice above me uttered such words.

page10.text:
...
The room is now silent.
The floating swords turned their gaze upon a single target on the floor and rained down upon them, piercing them.
The swords vanish after they have cut through flesh and bone,

page11.text:
leaving behind only traces of crimson.
"Hah...ugh...ah..."
She chose to be a shield.
Dragging her bloodied body, the woman looks back to the man she tried to protect.

page12.text:
"..."
Kuzuki says nothing.
While his Servant stands in front of him with countless piercing wounds.
...Maybe she feels she doesn't have to hide it anymore.
Taking down her hood, the woman shows her real face and slowly approaches her Master.

page13.text:
"Hah...ah...ah..."
...Her body is crumbling.
At the brink of her death, the woman looks upon her emotionless Master.
She gently caresses the man's face with her hand.

page14.text:
"Master, a-are you alright?"
Her breath getting shallower with each fading second.
Kuzuki shows no changes.
He simply utters a short confirmation, and he does not even bother to turn his gaze on Caster.

page15.text:
"I'm glad. I just can't...afford to see you die..."
This is fine... Wait.
...The woman lets out a smile realizing that perhaps she's content because of this man.

page16.text:
"Truly unfortunate. Just when I had...finally found my wish."
The woman's hand drops down from the man's face.
Caster's body starts to disintegrate from her feet.

page17.text:
"No need for you to weep. It simply means I will fulfill your wishes in your stead."
His simple and straight answer makes her smile.
She smiles, and looks at him like she's staring into a fading dream,
"I don't think that will be possible. Because my wish..."

page18.text:
...had already been fulfilled.
The great witch fades away as she falls to her eternal slumber.

page19.text:
...Her purple robe falls to the ground.
Without its owner, the robe also follows its master and fades into the wind.

page20.text:
"..."
Not spending a moment looking at Caster, Kuzuki had turned his attention to that guy.
To the guy probably standing above me, to the knight wearing a red cloak.

page21.text:
...My head hurts.
It's not from the burden of Projecting too many weapons.
It's that chant.
The chant that came out of that guy's mouth is attacking my brain with a constant feeling of nausea.

page22.text:
...Trace on.
I'm certain that's what he said.
I keep telling myself it's not possible for him to whisper those words, but without a doubt he uttered those exact words.

page23.text:
...
Archer walks down into the church.
Tohsaka stares at Archer and is probably still doubting her own eyes.

page24.text:
"...A-Archer... I had thought of the possibility but...did you really?"
...
Archer is not saying a word.
He focuses his sight solely on his enemy, Kuzuki.

page25.text:
"...A viper in one's bosom. I see. That was your plan from the very beginning, Archer."
"Right. But considering she was one of the many legends uttered in Greek mythology,
I would say a Trojan Horse would be the more fitting description here."
Archer betrayed Caster right in front of her Master, yet he shows no traces of regret facing the same man.

page26.text:
"I see. It's Caster's fault for bringing someone like you into our fold."
Even with the traitor standing in front of him, Kuzuki shows no changes in his tone.
He still has fight left in him.
He's not a mage, and he's lost Caster, but Kuzuki still has the will to keep this fight going…

page27.text:
...He resumes his combat stance.
Without Caster, Kuzuki's combat ability should have decreased drastically.
Even if he's still the same dangerous viper, Caster's boon that turned his fists to steel should've been gone by now.
Despite that, Kuzuki still decides to face Archer.

page28.text:
"I see. I won't stop you if you wish to continue."
Archer takes up his swords.
There are unseen sparks between them. The battle is set to begin.

page29.text:
"Wha..."
Is that really for the best?
Kuzuki said he's not interested in the Holy Grail.
He was simply here to accompany Caster. Truly a Master in name only.
If that's the case, there shouldn't be any more reasons for Kuzuki to keep fighting now that Caster is gone.

page30.text:
"...Wait. Why are you doing this, Kuzuki? You were just following what Caster told you to do, right? Caster is not here anymore, you shouldn't have any more reasons to fight."
My head hurts so much that my consciousness is fading, but I'm fixing my sights on the both of them.

page31.text:
...
Kuzuki closes his eyes for but a brief moment and answers…

page32.text: "You're right, I have no reason to fight. Because you see, like you, I'm not interested in this thing you call the Holy Grail."

page33.text:
"Then..."
"However, this is something I've started. It means I can't just walk away and not finish what I've started."
It's simple.
His answer is plain and simple.

page34.text:
...The fight begins.
This battle between them will probably end in a single encounter.
Even if Kuzuki possesses martial arts and skills beyond that of a simple human, his opponent is a Servant.
Simply being better than normal humans is not enough.

page35.text:
This fight is just an excuse to tighten up a loose end.
This is the fate of the loser.
A fight between the two Masters is always going to be kill or be killed, so what's going happen to Kuzuki is to be expected. If one is going to have a problem with this then don't ever step into this war.
Even so...
